title: 품사 - 부사 자리
explanation: 동사를 수식하는 부사 자리에는 부사(-ly)가 와야 한다.
correctExample: The marketing team worked diligently to complete the promotional campaign before the product launch.
incorrectExample: The marketing team worked diligent to complete the promotional campaign.
tip: 동사 뒤에서 동사를 수식하면 부사(-ly)를 선택한다.

title: 품사 - 명사 자리
explanation: 'their' 뒤에는 명사가 와야 한다. appreciate(동사), appreciative(형용사), appreciably(부사)는 해당 자리에 올 수 없다.
correctExample: The board of directors expressed their appreciation for the creative solutions proposed by the design team.
incorrectExample: The board of directors expressed their appreciate for the creative solutions.

title: 품사 - 형용사 자리
explanation: be동사 뒤 보어 자리 또는 명사 앞 수식어 자리에는 형용사가 온다.
correctExample: The new policy was beneficial to all employees in the organization.
incorrectExample: The new policy was benefit to all employees.

title: 품사 - 명사 자리 (주어)
explanation: 문장의 주어 자리에는 명사가 와야 한다.
correctExample: The completion of the renovation project is expected by the end of this quarter.
incorrectExample: The complete of the renovation project is expected.

title: 품사 - 부사 자리 (형용사 수식)
explanation: 형용사 앞에서 형용사를 수식하는 것은 부사이다.
correctExample: The newly renovated hotel is conveniently located near the city center and public transport.
incorrectExample: The newly renovated hotel is convenient located near the city center.

title: 품사 - 형용사 자리 (명사 수식)
explanation: 관사(a/an/the) + ___ + 명사 구조에서 빈칸에는 형용사가 온다.
correctExample: Due to considerable delays in shipping, customers will receive a partial refund.
incorrectExample: Due to considerable delays in shipping, customers will receive a part refund.

title: 품사 - 명사 자리 (목적어)
correctExample: The company needs to increase productivity in order to remain competitive in the market.
incorrectExample: The company needs to increase productive in order to remain competitive.

title: 품사 - 부사 (문장 수식)
explanation: 문장 전체를 수식하는 부사는 문두에 올 수 있다.
correctExample: Unfortunately, the annual budget meeting has been postponed until further notice.
incorrectExample: Unfortunate, the annual budget meeting has been postponed.

title: 품사 - 형용사 (보어)
explanation: remain, become, seem 같은 연결동사 뒤에는 형용사 보어가 온다.
correctExample: Employees must remain attentive during the safety training session at all times.
incorrectExample: Employees must remain attention during the safety training session.

title: 품사 - 명사 (전치사의 목적어)
correctExample: The success of the project depends on the cooperation between all departments.
incorrectExample: The success of the project depends on the cooperate between all departments.

title: 시제 - 현재완료
correctExample: Ms. Rivera has reviewed the sales reports every Monday morning since she joined the company last year.
incorrectExample: Ms. Rivera reviews the sales reports every Monday morning since she joined.

title: 시제 - 수동태
explanation: 주어가 동작의 대상일 때 수동태(be + p.p.)를 사용한다.
correctExample: Revised safety guidelines will be distributed to all laboratory staff members via email by the end of this week.
incorrectExample: Revised safety guidelines will distribute to all laboratory staff members.
tip: 주어(guidelines)가 배포되는 대상 → will be + p.p.

title: 시제 - 미래시제
explanation: 'next week', 'tomorrow' 등 미래 시간 표현과 함께 will 또는 be going to를 사용한다.
correctExample: The CEO will announce the new environmental policy during the upcoming annual general meeting.
incorrectExample: The CEO announced the new environmental policy during the upcoming meeting.

title: 수 일치 - 단수주어
explanation: 'Each of + 복수명사'는 단수 취급하여 단수 동사를 사용한다.
correctExample: Each of the participants has received a certificate of completion after the workshop.
incorrectExample: Each of the participants have received a certificate.

title: 시제 - 과거완료
explanation: 과거의 특정 시점 이전에 완료된 동작은 과거완료(had + p.p.)를 사용한다.
correctExample: By the time the manager arrived, the team had already submitted the quarterly report.
incorrectExample: By the time the manager arrived, the team already submitted the quarterly report.
tip: By the time + 과거 → had + p.p.

title: 수동태 - 현재진행 수동
explanation: 현재 진행 중인 수동 동작은 is/are being + p.p.로 표현한다.
correctExample: The conference room is being renovated and will not be available until next Friday.
incorrectExample: The conference room is renovating and will not be available.
tip: 주어가 행위의 대상 + 진행 중 → is being + p.p.

title: 시제 - 현재시제 (일반적 사실)
explanation: 일반적 사실이나 규칙을 나타낼 때는 현재시제를 사용한다.
correctExample: The company requires all new employees to attend a three-day orientation program.
incorrectExample: The company required all new employees to attend a three-day orientation.

title: to부정사 vs 동명사
explanation: plan, decide, expect 등의 동사 뒤에는 to부정사가 온다.
correctExample: The management decided to implement a new remote work policy starting next month.
incorrectExample: The management decided implementing a new remote work policy.

title: 분사 - 현재분사 수식
explanation: 명사를 능동적으로 수식하는 현재분사(-ing)와 수동적으로 수식하는 과거분사(-ed)를 구별해야 한다.
correctExample: Customers participating in the loyalty program will receive exclusive discounts this month.
incorrectExample: Customers participated in the loyalty program will receive exclusive discounts.

title: 가정법 - should 생략 도치
explanation: 제안/요구/명령 동사(suggest, recommend, require) 뒤 that절에서는 동사원형을 사용한다.
correctExample: The safety inspector recommended that the factory install additional fire extinguishers immediately.
incorrectExample: The safety inspector recommended that the factory installs additional fire extinguishers.

title: 접속사 vs 전치사 - Despite
correctExample: Despite the heavy rain, the outdoor concert proceeded as scheduled without any delays.
incorrectExample: Although the heavy rain, the outdoor concert proceeded as scheduled.

title: 접속사 - Although
explanation: although는 양보의 접속사로, 뒤에 주어+동사가 오는 완전한 절이 온다.
correctExample: Although the proposal was well-received, the board decided to delay the project until next quarter.
incorrectExample: Despite the proposal was well-received, the board decided to delay.

title: 접속사 - Because
explanation: 이유를 나타내는 접속사 because 뒤에는 완전한 절(S+V)이 온다.
correctExample: The meeting was postponed because several key members were unavailable on the proposed date.
incorrectExample: The meeting was postponed because of several key members were unavailable.
tip: because + S + V / because of + 명사구

title: 전치사 - during
explanation: during은 전치사로, 뒤에 명사(구)가 온다. while은 접속사로 절이 온다.
correctExample: Employees are expected to turn off their phones during the annual shareholders meeting.
incorrectExample: Employees are expected to turn off their phones while the annual shareholders meeting.

title: 접속부사 - However
explanation: however는 접속부사로, 앞 문장과 역접 관계를 나타낸다. 세미콜론이나 마침표 뒤에 온다.
correctExample: The initial sales figures were disappointing. However, the company managed to recover in the third quarter.
incorrectExample: The initial sales figures were disappointing however the company managed to recover.

title: 전치사 - in addition to
explanation: in addition to는 전치사구로 '~에 더하여'의 의미이며, 뒤에 명사(구)가 온다.
correctExample: In addition to the salary increase, employees will receive improved health benefits this year.
incorrectExample: In addition to the salary increase, employees will receives improved health benefits.

title: 접속사 - so that
explanation: 'so that + S + can/will'은 목적을 나타내는 접속사구이다.
correctExample: The company redesigned its website so that customers could navigate more easily.
incorrectExample: The company redesigned its website in order customers could navigate more easily.

title: 접속사 - whereas
explanation: whereas는 대조를 나타내는 접속사로, 두 가지를 비교할 때 사용한다.
correctExample: The marketing department favors digital advertising, whereas the sales team prefers in-person events.
incorrectExample: The marketing department favors digital advertising, despite the sales team prefers in-person events.

title: 전치사 - prior to
explanation: prior to는 '~이전에'라는 뜻의 전치사구로, before와 같은 의미이다.
correctExample: All applications must be submitted prior to the deadline on November thirtieth.
incorrectExample: All applications must be submitted prior the deadline on November thirtieth.

title: 접속사 - once
correctExample: Once the renovation is complete, the office will be able to accommodate fifty additional employees.
incorrectExample: After once the renovation is complete, the office will accommodate fifty additional employees.

title: 대명사 - 재귀대명사
explanation: 주어와 목적어가 같은 대상을 가리키면 재귀대명사(themselves)를 사용한다.
correctExample: Mr. Kim asked the interns to double-check the documents by themselves before submitting them to the manager.
incorrectExample: Mr. Kim asked the interns to double-check the documents by them before submitting.

title: 대명사 - 소유대명사
explanation: '소유격+명사'를 대신하는 소유대명사(theirs, ours 등)를 구별해야 한다.
correctExample: Our office is located downtown, and theirs is in the suburban business district.
incorrectExample: Our office is located downtown, and them is in the suburban business district.
tip: 빈칸 뒤에 명사가 없고 대신할 때 → 소유대명사

title: 관계대명사 - who (주격)
explanation: 사람을 선행사로 하고 주어 역할을 하는 관계대명사는 who이다.
correctExample: Customers who wish to receive a full refund must present their original receipt within thirty days of purchase.
incorrectExample: Customers whom wish to receive a full refund must present their original receipt.

title: 관계대명사 - which (사물)
correctExample: The report, which was submitted last Friday, contained several important recommendations for improvement.
incorrectExample: The report, who was submitted last Friday, contained several important recommendations.

title: 대명사 - 목적격
explanation: 타동사나 전치사의 목적어로는 목적격 대명사(them, us)를 사용한다.
correctExample: The supervisor reminded them to submit the expense reports before the end of the month.
incorrectExample: The supervisor reminded they to submit the expense reports.

title: 어휘 - 동사
explanation: 'announce'는 '발표하다, 공표하다'로, 공식적 자리에서 정보를 알릴 때 사용한다.
correctExample: The CEO plans to announce the new environmental policy during the upcoming annual general meeting.
incorrectExample: The CEO plans to notify the new environmental policy during the upcoming meeting.
tip: announce: 공식 발표 / notify: 개별 통지 / inform: 정보 전달 / speak: 자동사

title: 어휘 - 형용사
explanation: 'mandatory'는 '의무적인'이라는 뜻으로, 반드시 해야 하는 것을 나타낸다.
correctExample: All employees are required to attend the safety training session, as it is mandatory for maintaining a secure workplace.
incorrectExample: All employees are required to attend the safety training, as it is confident for maintaining a secure workplace.
tip: mandatory: 의무적인 / confident: 자신감 있는 / spacious: 넓은 / reluctant: 꺼리는

title: 어휘 - 부사
correctExample: The newly renovated hotel is conveniently located near the major tourist attractions and public transport.
incorrectExample: The newly renovated hotel is extremely located near the major tourist attractions.

title: 어휘 - 동사 (제출)
explanation: 'submit'은 '제출하다'로, 문서나 보고서를 공식적으로 낼 때 사용한다.
correctExample: Please submit your travel expense report to the accounting department by this Friday.
incorrectExample: Please deliver your travel expense report to the accounting department.
tip: submit: 제출하다 / deliver: 배달하다 / transfer: 이전하다 / forward: 전달하다

title: 어휘 - 형용사 (적절한)
correctExample: Please wear appropriate attire for the company dinner event next Saturday evening.
incorrectExample: Please wear approximate attire for the company dinner event.
tip: appropriate: 적절한 / approximate: 대략적인 / accessible: 접근가능한 / applicable: 적용가능한

title: 어휘 - 동사 (준수하다)
explanation: 'comply with'는 '준수하다'로, 규정이나 법률을 따를 때 사용한다.
correctExample: All contractors must comply with the safety regulations outlined in the construction guidelines.
incorrectExample: All contractors must apply with the safety regulations outlined.
tip: comply with: 준수하다 / apply: 신청하다 / supply: 공급하다 / reply: 응답하다

title: 어휘 - 명사 (절차)
correctExample: The new hiring procedure has significantly reduced the time needed to fill open positions.
incorrectExample: The new hiring process has significantly reduced the time needed to fill open positions.
tip: procedure: 절차 / process: 과정 / progress: 진행 / practice: 관행

title: 어휘 - 부사 (상당히)
correctExample: Sales revenue has increased considerably since the launch of the new marketing campaign.
incorrectExample: Sales revenue has increased considerately since the launch of the new marketing campaign.
tip: considerably: 상당히 / considerately: 사려깊게 / consistently: 일관되게 / consecutively: 연속으로

title: 어휘 - 형용사 (예상된)
explanation: 'prospective'는 '장래의, 유망한'이라는 뜻으로, 아직 확정되지 않은 미래의 대상을 나타낸다.
correctExample: Prospective clients are invited to attend a free demonstration of our software on Thursday.
incorrectExample: Perspective clients are invited to attend a free demonstration of our software.
tip: prospective: 장래의(고객) / perspective: 관점 / respective: 각각의 / productive: 생산적인

title: 어휘 - 동사 (보장하다)
explanation: 'ensure'는 '보장하다, 확실히 하다'로, 확실한 결과를 보장할 때 사용한다.
correctExample: The quality control team works to ensure that all products meet the highest standards.
incorrectExample: The quality control team works to assure that all products meet the highest standards.
tip: ensure: (일이) 확실히 되도록 하다 / assure: (사람을) 안심시키다 / insure: 보험에 들다 / endure: 견디다

title: 어휘 - 형용사 (포괄적인)
correctExample: The training program provides a comprehensive overview of the company policies and procedures.
incorrectExample: The training program provides a comprehensible overview of the company policies.
tip: comprehensive: 포괄적인 / comprehensible: 이해할수있는 / compulsory: 의무적인 / competitive: 경쟁적인

title: 어휘 - 동사 (allocate)
explanation: 'allocate'는 '배분하다, 할당하다'로, 자원이나 예산을 배분할 때 사용한다.
correctExample: The finance department will allocate additional funds to the research division next quarter.
incorrectExample: The finance department will locate additional funds to the research division.
tip: allocate: 배분하다 / locate: 위치시키다 / advocate: 옹호하다 / elaborate: 정교하게 만들다

title: 어휘 - 부사 (즉시)
correctExample: All customer complaints should be addressed promptly to maintain a high level of satisfaction.
incorrectExample: All customer complaints should be addressed properly to maintain a high level of satisfaction.
tip: promptly: 즉시 / properly: 적절히 / previously: 이전에 / presumably: 아마

title: 어휘 - 형용사 (효율적인)
explanation: 'efficient'는 '효율적인'으로, 자원을 낭비 없이 사용하는 것을 나타낸다.
correctExample: The new automated system is highly efficient and has reduced processing time by forty percent.
incorrectExample: The new automated system is highly effective and has reduced processing time.
tip: efficient: 효율적인 / effective: 효과적인 / sufficient: 충분한 / proficient: 능숙한

title: 어휘 - 명사 (혜택)
correctExample: The company offers competitive benefits including health insurance and retirement plans.
incorrectExample: The company offers competitive profits including health insurance and retirement plans.
tip: benefits: 혜택(복지) / profits: 이익(수익) / revenues: 매출 / outcomes: 결과

title: 어휘 - 동사 (검토하다)
explanation: 'review'는 검토하다로, 제출물을 공식적으로 살펴볼 때 사용한다.
correctExample: The committee will review all submitted proposals before making a final decision.

title: 어휘 - 형용사 (충분한)
correctExample: The applicant has sufficient experience to qualify for the senior management position.

title: 어휘 - 동사 (postpone)
explanation: postpone: 연기하다 / cancel: 취소하다 / delay: 지연시키다
correctExample: The annual conference has been postponed due to unexpected scheduling conflicts.

title: 품사 - 형용사 (available)
correctExample: All seminar rooms are currently available for reservation through the online booking system.

title: 어휘 - 명사 (inquiry)
correctExample: For any further inquiries regarding the product warranty, please contact our customer service team.

title: 시제 - 현재완료진행
correctExample: The development team has been working on the new mobile application for the past six months.

title: 어휘 - 부사 (significantly)
correctExample: Profits have increased significantly since the company expanded into international markets.

title: 접속사 - unless
correctExample: Employees will not be eligible for the bonus unless they complete the required training program.

title: 어휘 - 형용사 (eligible)
correctExample: Only full-time employees are eligible for the company health insurance plan.

title: 품사 - 부사 (significantly)
correctExample: The renovation project has been significantly delayed due to supply chain issues.

title: 어휘 - 동사 (accommodate)
correctExample: The new conference center can accommodate up to five hundred attendees at one time.

title: 시제 - 수동태 현재완료
correctExample: More than two hundred applications have been received for the marketing manager position.

title: 어휘 - 형용사 (outstanding)
correctExample: Ms. Chen received an award for her outstanding contributions to the research department.

title: 접속사 - provided that
correctExample: The contract will be renewed provided that both parties agree to the revised terms and conditions.

title: 어휘 - 동사 (implement)
correctExample: The IT department plans to implement the new security measures by the end of the month.

title: 품사 - 명사 (authorization)
correctExample: Employees must obtain written authorization from their supervisor before accessing confidential files.

title: 어휘 - 부사 (respectively)
correctExample: The Seoul and Busan offices will relocate on March first and April fifteenth, respectively.

title: 대명사 - those who
correctExample: Those who have not yet registered for the seminar should do so before the end of this week.

title: 어휘 - 형용사 (affordable)
correctExample: The restaurant is known for serving affordable meals without compromising on quality.

title: 시제 - 조건절 (현재시제)
correctExample: If the shipment arrives on time, we will begin the installation process immediately.

title: 어휘 - 동사 (negotiate)
correctExample: The two companies are currently trying to negotiate a new partnership agreement.

title: 품사 - 형용사 (preliminary)
correctExample: The preliminary results of the survey indicate high customer satisfaction with the new product.

title: 어휘 - 명사 (itinerary)
correctExample: Please check the detailed itinerary for the business trip before departing next Monday.

title: 접속사 - not only A but also B
explanation: not only A but also B: A뿐만 아니라 B도
correctExample: The program not only improves employee skills but also enhances team collaboration.

title: 어휘 - 형용사 (tentative)
correctExample: The tentative schedule for the conference is subject to change depending on speaker availability.

title: 품사 - 부사 (thoroughly)
correctExample: All equipment must be thoroughly inspected before being shipped to the client.

title: 어휘 - 동사 (reimburse)
correctExample: The company will reimburse employees for any travel expenses incurred during business trips.

title: 전치사 - regardless of
correctExample: All team members must attend the meeting, regardless of their current project assignments.
distractors: instead of,in terms of,in spite of

title: 어휘 - 형용사 (adjacent)
correctExample: The new parking facility is adjacent to the main office building and accessible to all employees.

title: 시제 - be to 용법
correctExample: The annual report is to be finalized and submitted to the board by the end of this month.

title: 어휘 - 동사 (revise)
correctExample: The editorial team was asked to revise the manuscript before the publication deadline.

title: 품사 - 명사 (proficiency)
correctExample: Applicants must demonstrate proficiency in at least two programming languages to qualify.

title: 어휘 - 부사 (exclusively)
correctExample: This offer is available exclusively to members who have maintained their subscription for over one year.

title: 접속사 - in case
correctExample: Please bring an umbrella in case it rains during the outdoor ceremony this afternoon.

title: 어휘 - 형용사 (substantial)
correctExample: The research project received substantial funding from several international organizations.

title: 품사 - 형용사 (reliable)
correctExample: Our company is looking for a reliable supplier who can deliver materials on a consistent schedule.

title: 어휘 - 동사 (anticipate)
correctExample: Analysts anticipate that the company will report record profits in the upcoming fiscal year.

title: 전치사 - as of
correctExample: As of January first, the new pricing structure will take effect for all subscription plans.

title: 어휘 - 형용사 (complimentary)
correctExample: All conference attendees will receive a complimentary copy of the latest industry report.

title: 품사 - 부사 (accurately)
correctExample: All data entries must be recorded accurately to prevent errors in the financial statements.

title: 어휘 - 동사 (designate)
correctExample: The city council has designated several new areas for commercial development.

title: 관계부사 - where
correctExample: The factory where the latest model is manufactured has passed all safety inspections.

title: 어휘 - 형용사 (feasible)
correctExample: After careful evaluation, the committee determined that the proposal was financially feasible.

title: 품사 - 명사 (compliance)
correctExample: Strict compliance with environmental regulations is required for all manufacturing facilities.

title: 어휘 - 동사 (expedite)
correctExample: To expedite the shipping process, customers may choose the express delivery option at checkout.

title: 접속사 - as long as
correctExample: Employees may work from home as long as they maintain regular communication with their team.
distractors: as well as,as much as,as far as

title: 어휘 - 부사 (approximately)
correctExample: The construction of the new headquarters is expected to take approximately eighteen months.

title: 품사 - 형용사 (detailed)
correctExample: A detailed analysis of the quarterly performance will be presented at the next board meeting.

title: 어휘 - 동사 (discontinue)
